topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I understand the need for boundaries, for places to call our own. When my neighbor approached me about the fence, I listened carefully to their thoughts and plans. I imagined the privacy it would give them, the sense of security. I nodded, seeing the way their eyes lit up, not just with the practical benefits, but with a vision of a space that felt more theirs. I shared my own ideas, suggesting a few places where the fence might blend nicely with the existing landscape, maybe even enhance it. We talked about plants that could soften the edges, about the kind of wood that would age well and look good for years to come. It felt good to support them, to be a part of this small step they were taking to shape their home.
